description:
Hades 2 is a rogue-like dungeon crawler in which the witch Melinoe battles
through the Underworld to defeat the Titan of Time, Chronos.

0.2.0.description:
Renamed to Hades2Rogue to differentiate from existing Hades 2 implementation.

Fixed the multiple room locations not sending, but this time for real.
0.2.0.title: v0.2.0

v0.10.0.description:
## Biggest changes:
- Enemy_locations replaced with Enemysanity option, which allows players to shuffle or randomize enemies in addition to setting them as locations. The shuffle and random modes are still experimental, so expect some major bugs if you select those options.
- Dream route added! Along with options to make it feel unique. Shoutout to zerp and their DreamDiveTweaks mod for allowing runs to go past 4 regions.
- Added progressive_per to Keepsakesanity and Petsanity, which adds progressive checks for each individual keepsake/pet.
- Minibosses aren't shuffled like normal enemies. Instead include_minibosses shuffles the miniboss rooms, so you might walk into a miniboss room in Erebus and find Charybdis.
- Room locations are now numbered per region instead of per route, and defeating a region's boss sends any room locations you have left in that region.
- Added Chaos to GodSanity.
- Chaos Gates can now show up in every region of the Underworld and Surface, instead of only a few.
- Reworked the Hades 2 tab in the client. It now shows your progress through each region, your goal progress, and lists of what you've checked. It also no longer relies on color to tell you things.
- Reworked DeathLink so deaths no longer queue up.

## Other Changes:
- Legendary and Duo boons are now more likely with more rarity increases.
- NPCs that spawn in different ways should now send their keepsakes regardless of where you give them nectar.
- Tried to fix some issues with when the Daedalus Upgrade item is applying.
- Fixed location issues in Fields of Mourning and Tartarus. Primarily that Fields of Mourning wasn't sending locations for each encounter, instead only sending them when you walk through the door. Tartarus was only sending locations when completing a bonus side room.
- Fixed players who had things set up incorrectly being permanently locked out of checks. Once the issue is corrected, locations should send as normal.
- Overlay now notes who you received items from.
- Attempted suppression of some camera takeovers when first entering the Crossroads hub. I will be working on this more as I catch more.
- Tried a really simple fix to hopefully stop armor from continuing to show as the screen blacks out during deaths.
- Zagreus Journey failed to install correctly message should now be suppressed if players have Zagreus Journey disabled in the YAML.
- Split Met and Defeated checks for Scylla and the Sirens into Scylla, Roxy, and Jetty.
- Added a seed-identity guard so starting a new Archipelago without closing the game shouldn't ever send locations from a previous archipelago connection.
- Chaos Gates should now count as rooms, since my previous assumption that they were extra is not correct.
- Room counter should now always show the room you're in instead of the last room you sent.
- Removed the hide and seek locations, and suppressed that flashback from ever happening.
- Vow of Menace can now pull enemies from regions you haven't visited yet.
- Suppressed all resource-gathering spots since there isn't a way to use them in the AP, and I don't intend to use them for anything.
- Suppressed the "Divination of the Elements" pop-up the first time a player collects a boon.
- Added 0.10.0 stuff to the Guided YAML and YAML Creator.
- Fixed an issue where Nightmare route was still locked until an unlock was sent even if players disabled lock_routes.
- Made ZJ an optional dependency. It's no longer downloaded with the mod, so if you want the Nightmare route, download it yourself in r2modman.
- DreamDiveTweaks is now a dependency, and is downloaded with the mod.
- Fixed room locations not sending if a later room in that region had already been sent by someone else (a collect, a release, or an admin).
- Room logic is more forgiving, the last rooms of a region aren't expected until you can beat its boss.
- Fixed per_aspect_room_based with combine_pools not creating any aspect room locations.
- Final Challenge now ends the run right after the victory screen when you defeat Zagreus, and fixed a few issues with where the Zagreus contract sent you afterwards.
- Fixed a crash in GodSanity when a boon was offered while you had no gods unlocked.
- Fixed gods you hadn't unlocked yet showing up in the first room of Ephyra.
- Fixed Daedalus Hammers rarely showing up in runs with GodSanity.
- Fixed some Starting NPC gifts not doing anything.
- Grasp can no longer be bought at the altar, since it comes from items.
- Helper story rooms should no longer show up as the very first room of a Nightmare region.
- Keepsake and Met locations can all be sent from a Dream Dive.
- If you win while the client is disconnected, the win is now saved and sent once you reconnect.
- start_inventory_from_pool now works with Grasp, Arcana, Keepsakes, and Vow Removals.
- Setting a filler's percentage to 0 now actually means you get none of it. Nectar was sneaking in anyway.
- Item and location IDs are now locked in place, so future updates shouldn't break seeds generated on older versions.
- The Surface door now opens as soon as you receive access to it, instead of needing to leave the room and come back.
- Fixed a crash that could happen when a combat helper showed up somewhere they normally don't.
- Fixed a rare case where the same room could repeat forever.
- With combine_pools, the shared pool is no longer sent early when your goal needs more than one route.
- Fixed some option combinations failing to generate correctly.
- Fixed Universal Tracker not counting some items towards logic.
v0.10.0.title: Hades 2 Rogue v0.10.0

v0.3.0.description:
Fixed the following issues:
Starting Max Health and Starting Max Arcana items not working
Quitting and rejoining midrun randomizes the Daedalus upgrades you receive from the Daedalus Upgrade item
NPCs won't give you their keepsakes, and therefore send their keepsake location, if you already have their keepsake.
A bunch of logic issues for when you are only doing one route.
Rarity increase feature didn't work.
v0.3.0.title: v0.3.0

v0.4.0.description:
Added Zagreus as an additional goal option, changed some other goal options to include him
When a route is completed (Meaning that routes boss has been defeated the amount of times required by the YAML), all of the core locations from that route are released.
Hopefully fixed the bug where some players got "APWorld appears to be invalid or damaged" error message when trying to install the APWorld? I think I was just packaging it incorrectly, but it always worked for me, so I don't really have a way to test this.
Added /deathlink command to the client so you can enable/disable deathlink mid-run

Zagreus' stuff has only been tested once since I don't have a ton of time to test, marking this as prerelease for that reason.

v0.5.0.description:
# Added new features:
- AspectSanity "Per_Aspect" mode, where all 24 aspects gets 5 progressive checks associated with it, adding 120 total items to the item pool.
- Randomized and Per_Aspect modes start you with a random aspect, not always Melinoe's (Not tested super thoroughly)
- All gods are available from the beginning, so your first run isn't pretty much always Apollo, Aphrodite, and Poseidon.


## Fixed a number of issues, including:
**Zagreus Fixes**
- Redesigning Zagreus Final Challenge so it actually works consistently, instead of just putting you right in the fight it'll spawn the contract
- Fixed an issue that resulted from that change, where you would go into the Zagreus fights with none of your build, which is very funny, but not ideal.
- Redesigned how the run ends when you kill Zagreus.
- Fixed Zagreus showing up in every shop in either of the two options, regardless of whether you'd defeated him already.
- Ensured the infernal contract won't ever show up in the shop if it's set to Final Challenge.
- Made it so the zagreus_encounter_mode, zagreus_defeats_needed, and zagreus_weaken_tiers actually do something, because apparently I wired that up wrong.
**Bridge Connection Fixes/Diagnostics**
- Added some additional logging so it's easier to determine what's going wrong between the mod and the AP client
definitely not happen anymore (Theoretically, maybe)
- Added some extra diagnostic stuff when using /bridge in the client
- Removed the ability for players to change the port for the client/mod connection in the mod config, since there is no way of changing it for the client, and it's a bit confusing when there is also a archipelago server and port that people associate more with those concepts.

## Also
- Consolidated some of the bookkeeping for the Weapon-unlocks
- Receiving certain items during boon-selection should no longer soft-lock your game.
- Fixed a theoretical issue where if you run multiple seeds, it might use initial settings from the first run when launching into the second run. I never had this issue despite trying to reproduce for awhile, but it should 
- Eris should no longer break your game when giving you a curse, and should stop giving you said curse.
v0.5.0.title: v0.5.0

v0.6.0.description:
**Added Zagreus Journey:** A whole 3rd route using the Zagreus Journey mod by NikkelM. You'll need to have Hades installed alongside the mod in order for it to work. Be warned that it will not work unless you have a downloaded copy of Hades 1. Also added all of the applicable locations, incantations, keepsakes, etc.

Core checks now count additional encounters in the same room as separate rooms. (Fields of Mourning and Rift of Thessaly)

Massive YAML rewrite to make things clearer, hopefully.


**A crap ton of bug fixes, including:**

Starting aspect randomly reasserting itself in portions of the code, breaking daedalus hammers sometimes.
Keepsake rack not opening until a player actually gives a nectar to someone.
Deathlink had a ton of issues that I fixed, but I think there are others I need to find. I would really appreciate any feedback on this, since most of my testing is done solo, so it's difficult to find and stamp out the bugs in the edge cases
Some item collision issues.
Met Selene firing incorrectly.
Some enemy defeated checks not sending when said enemy is defeated
Various other small things I caught
v0.6.0.title: v0.6.0

v0.7.0.description:
Many many changes, including but not limited to:

Combat and Room helper randomization
Godsanity (Still not perfect, but should be stable)
Aspect and Weapon sanity adjustments
Added Universal Tracker integration
Added a new Hades 2 tab that tracks some of your received items
You start in the route you're supposed to, instead of dying if it's not underworld
Adjusted Zagreus spawning
Added Progressive Boon Level
Added starting helper boons, and wrapped Starting Arachne Armor into it
Adjusted goal completion detection
Heavily adjusted logic so that it should feel much much better now
Adjusted what is considered an "Encounter" for score and room locations.

And a bunch of bug fixes
v0.7.0.title: v0.7.0

v0.7.1.description:
Bug Fixes:
 - Sisyphus icon mapped incorrectly for the Hades 2 tab.
 - Hopefully setup the mod to adjust for a version mismatch
 - If a helper room is rolled and the player hasn't unlocked any helpers, it should now reroll to a different type of room.
 - Fixed loading order when Archipelago launches to correct for some conflicts with other Apworlds
v0.7.1.title: v0.7.1

v0.7.2.description:
### Bugfixes and Adjustments
- Fixed a couple bugs that the player was unlikely to ever see.
- Made some adjustments to better future-proof
- Removed game assets from the client
- Wrote a setup guide and general info document within a docs folder in the APWorld
- Other minor adjustments
### Mod Unchanged, only effects the APWorld
v0.7.2.title: v0.7.2

v0.8.0.description:
# Hades 2 Rogue V0.8.0
A few new features, and a whole lot of bug fixes.
v0.8.0.title: v0.8.0

v0.9.0.description:
- Added a [Github Pages site](https://brittish39.github.io/Hades2Archipelago/#yaml) where you can create a YAML more easily. 
- Added Per_aspect_per_room for you sickos out there. This alone should be considered pre-release build, but I'm releasing the patch as full release because this is more stable than 0.8.0 outside of potential issues with that feature hardly anyone will use.
- Corrected for a bug where even if you didn't have Zagreus Journey enabled, missing the Hades 1 install would still break everything.
v0.9.0.title: v0.9.0

v0.9.3.description:
- Weapon_clears_needed was incorrectly being enforced as a per-route quota instead of the intended shared quota.
- Medea, Heracles, and Chronos met checks can be sent as part of their vow of rivals appearances.
- Progressive Boon Level's level-up no longer overwrites the Jeweled Pom but instead adds to it.
- When out of Helpers, rooms shouldn't show helper when they're being replaced with non-helper rooms.
- The miniboss prophecy is enabled from the beginning if you have enemy_locations on, so you can see if a room has a miniboss you haven't yet defeated.
- Text overlay should now keep it's entries.
- Removed Met Achilles and Achilles Keepsake locations

## Known Issues/Watch out for:
- Starting boons and Daedalus upgrades sometimes not applying from the beginning.
v0.9.3.title: Hades 2 Rogue v0.9.3
